720815.title: Cheongnamdae Spring Flower Festival
720815.overview: Spring at the former presidential villa on Daecheong Lake: flower displays, daily music performances, wildflower and bonsai exhibitions, plus art special exhibitions across the lakeside compound.

2952027.title: Korea Science Festival in Gyeonggi
2952027.overview: Korea's flagship science festival at KINTEX, themed 'imagination becomes daily life': 60 years of national research achievements plus AI-in-everyday-life exhibitions, hands-on programs, and shows over three April days. Free.

4057755.title: Asian Esports Games 2026
4057755.overview: Seven Asian nations compete in Jinju across six titles — PUBG Mobile, Street Fighter 6, Tekken 8, KOF XV, eFootball, Eternal Return — plus a K-pop dance AI platform as a demonstration event, wrapped in a culture-festival format. Free entry.
4057755.sponsor: Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism

2755521.title: Miryang Heritage Night Tour
2755521.overview: A night festival at Yeongnamnu — the grand riverside pavilion counted among Korea's three finest: the '8 nights' program with Eungcheon Arirang performances and falling-fire displays over the Miryang River, plus the Arirang market and artist stalls.

4058499.title: Nongae: Open-Air Historical Musical
4058499.overview: A musical staged on the Nam River itself, where the story happened: Nongae, the gisaeng who pulled a Japanese general into the water at Uiam Rock during the Imjin War, retold on a floating stage beneath the lit Chokseongnu pavilion with fireworks and full-scale staging. Runs during the Jinju Nongae Festival.

3108284.title: Udo Conch Festival
3108284.overview: Udo — the little island off Jeju's east coast — celebrates its horned turban conch: harbor restaurants serve conch dishes, the youth association grills samples, and visitors completing island challenges earn goods and boat discounts at Cheonjin Port.

629718.title: Gwangju Royal Ceramic Festival
629718.overview: Gwangju (Gyeonggi) housed the royal kilns that fired Joseon's palace porcelain, and its festival at Gonjiam Ceramic Park revives that lineage: wheel-throwing and traditional ceramic workshops, madang plays, performances channeling 500 years of royal ware, and K-pop guest stages.

2982690.title: Taebaek Heavenly Wild Greens Festival
2982690.overview: Korea's highest city greets its late spring with mountain greens: highland namul with intense flavor sold at source prices, plus food streets, night markets, contests, and performances at the Jangseong market grounds.

3487939.title: Gangseo Children's Fairy Tale Festival
3487939.overview: The 14th children's festival of Gangseo, themed 'fairy tales drawn together by children and AI': a street parade from the digital-content high school to Banghwa Park, then AI storybook experiences, rides, food, and shows.

3112269.title: Dureup Wild Greens Festival
3112269.overview: A village festival in Gapyeong for dureup (angelica shoots) and spring greens: farm markets, food stalls, music, prize draws, and children's programs at the Chorongi Nest village.

4058391.title: Hoeryongpo Spring Outing Festival
4058391.overview: Spring at Hoeryongpo — the famous river bend where the Naeseongcheon nearly circles a sand-island village: canola blooms, sand play, performances, and flea markets, with the observatory view over the meander ranking among Korea's best spring panoramas.

2949644.title: Spring Walk Seoul
2949644.overview: A non-competitive 7.5km spring walk around Namsan's northern loop from Baekbeom Plaza: warm-up stretching, brand booths and sampling, stage games, and a finisher medal — a packaged city-walking event (entry 42,000 won).

2818837.title: Jongmyo Myohyeonrye Ceremony
2818837.overview: The only Joseon state rite in which royal women took part: the newly married queen or crown princess presenting herself at Jongmyo shrine. The 2026 edition pairs a musical recreating Queen Inwon's 1703 ceremony with royal costume photo experiences at the UNESCO-listed shrine.

1574707.title: Yun Bong-gil Peace Festival
1574707.overview: A family peace festival at the shrine of independence hero Yun Bong-gil in his hometown of Yesan — education programs at his memorial hall, family activities at his birth home, and a youth exhibition marking 80 years since his remains returned to Korea.

1998564.title: Royal Culture Festival
1998564.overview: Korea's biggest heritage festival: nine days each spring and autumn across all five Seoul palaces and Jongmyo shrine — performances, rite reenactments, night openings, and experiences. The 12th edition, 'Palaces Awaken Art', opens with a night spectacle at Gyeongbokgung's Heungnyemun plaza. THE event to plan a spring Seoul trip around.
1998564.place: Gyeongbokgung, Changdeokgung, Deoksugung, Changgyeonggung, Gyeonghuigung, Jongmyo

506647.title: Asan Admiral Yi Sun-sin Festival
506647.overview: Asan — home of Hyeonchungsa, the national shrine to Admiral Yi — marks his birthday with its biggest festival, running since 1961: parades, reenactments, and programs on his life and loyalty across the hot-spring city and the shrine grounds.

513326.title: Ansan Street Arts Festival
513326.overview: Korea's leading street-arts festival since 2005: international and Korean companies transform Ansan's plazas and streets each May with aerial theater, large-scale spectacle, and intimate street pieces — expanded kids' zones and strong accessibility make it genuinely for everyone. Free.

553315.title: Yeosu Turtle Ship Festival
553315.overview: Yeosu was the headquarters of Admiral Yi's Jeolla Left Navy, and this festival marks the fleet's first sortie of May 1592: naval rite reenactments, parades, and programs around Yi Sun-sin Square in the old naval city where the turtle ship was built.

2984556.title: Imsil N Pet Festa
2984556.overview: Korea's boldest pet festival, in the county building a companion-animal cluster — held at the Osu Loyal Dog site, home of Korea's most famous dog legend: FCI agility competition, bonding programs, and a special dog-friendly train tour making the trip itself part of the festival.

2974166.title: Chajeon General & Princess Noguk Festival
2974166.overview: Andong's spring folk festival across the old downtown: the spectacular Chajeon Nori — massed log-frame battles pushed by teams of men — and Notdari Bapgi, the human-bridge walk of women, both centuries-old local traditions, joined by parades and international performances.
2974166.place: Andong Station 1942 and Mask Dance Park

3489178.title: Hajeon Clam Five-Senses Festival
3489178.overview: Wade into the UNESCO World Natural Heritage Gochang mudflats and dig your own clams: Hajeon village is Korea's biggest short-necked-clam producer, and May clams are at their plumpest. Cooking programs, food stalls, and discounted direct sales round out the tidal-flat day.

3113790.title: Haman Citizens' Day
3113790.overview: Haman's community day at Hamju Park: reunion halls, nongak competitions between townships, county sports day, performances, fireworks, food fairs, and free markets.

2597638.title: Hongcheon Wild Greens Festival
2597638.overview: Hongcheon — Korea's largest county, 85 percent forest — brings its high-mountain greens to market: myeongi, dureup, eomnamu shoots, and prized san-yangsam (wild-simulated ginseng), with a special grill house pairing fresh greens with Hongcheon pork.

4061420.title: Gwacheon Jazz Picnic
4061420.overview: Ten Korean and international jazz acts play free on Gwacheon's civic plaza while the audience picnics on the lawn — vocal-jazz-forward lineups, artist signings, coloring and soundbook programs, food trucks, and a delivery pickup zone.

3114868.title: Jinbong Saemangeum Barley Field Festival
3114868.overview: Green barley to the horizon on the Saemangeum plain: walk freely through the waving fields, browse farm markets, and let kids loose in the play zones — a photogenic green-season counterpart to autumn's golden paddies.

1553601.title: Busan Lotus Lantern Festival
1553601.overview: Busan's edition of Yeondeunghoe — the UNESCO-listed lantern festival for Buddha's Birthday: a grand lantern parade, traditional lantern exhibitions, and celebration stages at Songsanghyeon Square, carrying a 1,200-year tradition through the city night.

1241762.title: Seocheon Wild Flounder & Sea Bream Festival
1241762.overview: Wild-caught flounder and sea bream from the clean West Sea at Maryangjin Port: bare-hand flounder catching, boat-fishing trips, and harbor-fresh sashimi — a hands-on spring seafood weekend.

4060101.title: East Asia Culture City Andong
4060101.overview: Andong holds Korea's 2026 East Asia Culture City title, opening a year of Korea-China-Japan exchange: a three-country opening festival with traditional performances, East Asian games and food fairs, cooking classes, and city pavilions from the partner cities.
4060101.sponsor: Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism · Andong City

2865122.title: Hyeonchungsa Moonlight Night Tour
2865122.overview: The national shrine of Admiral Yi Sun-sin opens after dark for a spring edition: light-scaped grounds, performances, exhibitions, and hands-on programs giving the solemn shrine a different, softer register by night. Free.

2714144.title: Haman World Watermelon Festival
2714144.overview: Haman watermelons — famously sweet from the county's sun and soil — star in a festival of giant watermelon-punch sharing, tastings, contests, and performances at Hamju Park, at the source of one of Korea's favorite summer fruits.

3310483.title: Family Arts Festival TokTok
3310483.overview: Seoul's first fine-arts festival built for young children and parents: an outdoor painting canvas ('Paint TokTok'), a pop-up art playground ('Sense TokTok'), and movement-friendly performances ('Rhythm TokTok') around Seoseoul Lake Park for Family Month.
3310483.place: Seoul Arts Education Center Yangcheon and Seoseoul Lake Park
3310483.sponsor: Seoul Foundation for Arts and Culture

1591019.title: Goheung Aerospace Festival
1591019.overview: A space festival at Naro Space Center — Korea's rocket launch site: Black Eagles aerobatic shows, launch-vehicle site tours (advance booking), real hardware exhibitions, and family space programs under the slogan 'Space Signal'.

3488961.title: Elixir Expedition: Find the Herb of Immortality!
3488961.overview: A storytelling mission tour through Donguibogam Village in Sancheong: chatbot clues and mission books lead explorers through the herbal-medicine theme park's halls and gardens on the trail of the legendary elixir — learning the county's healing traditions along the way.

3115750.title: Children's Seonbi Festival
3115750.overview: Kids sit the state exam of Joseon: a play-based festival at Yeongju's Seonbi World teaching scholar-gentleman culture through a mock gwageo exam, honor parades for the 'top graduates', and Joseon-themed games across the traditional campus.

2968672.title: DDP Children's Design Festival
2968672.overview: DDP's outdoor spaces become a kids' design land over the Children's Day holidays: toy play, design play, and family play zones where children build, imagine, and create across the plaza and lawn hill. Free.

3489255.title: Boryeong Children's Day Celebration
3489255.overview: Children's Day at the Mud Expo Plaza, run alongside the AMC motor festival: K-pop dance and bubble shows, a puppet play, and two days of craft booths — keyrings, soap, perfume, cooking classes — plus a wooden playground and photo zones.

3545306.title: Pocheon Pet Festa: Spring Edition
3545306.overview: A pet festival in the Hantangang gorge parkland: dog trekking along the river, pet-fitness yoga, a dog olympics, live big-dog encyclopedia, kids' agility challenges, and a pet fair — open equally to visitors without pets.

3114696.title: Gangbuk Children's Day Festival
3114696.overview: Children's Day at North Seoul Dream Forest — the big green of northeast Seoul: magic, bubble, and character shows, craft and traditional-game booths, safety education, and play zones across the park (entry 1,000 won).

4058798.title: Children's Ceramics Festival
4058798.overview: The Gwangju National Museum marks its new ceramics culture hall with a hands-on kids' festival: children's wheel-throwing, a pottery market, expert talks, and outdoor performances over the Children's Day holidays. Free.

727285.title: Yanggu Gomchwi Festival
727285.overview: Gomchwi — the aromatic 'bear's greens' beloved for ssam wraps — peaks each May in Yanggu, its biggest growing region. Tastings and sales at source, performances, and family programs at the leports park in one of Korea's cleanest inland counties.

141759.title: Jongmyo Daeje Royal Ancestral Rite
141759.overview: The grand ancestral rite for Joseon's kings and queens at Jongmyo shrine — UNESCO-listed both as architecture and as living ritual, with its solemn court music and line dances performed as they were for 500 years. Held the first Sunday of May; one of the most profound spectacles in Korea, and free.

2545174.title: Young Choreographers Creative Showcase
2545174.overview: An annual platform staging new works by Korea's emerging choreographers, selected by open audition — the launching pad that has fed the country's contemporary dance scene for years. At the Daehangno Arts Theater small hall.

2816502.title: Seoul Circus Festival
2816502.overview: Korea's only circus-dedicated festival, on Nodeul Island around Children's Day: traditional big-top acts to contemporary circus — aerial, tightrope, juggling, acrobatics — plus try-it-yourself workshops, exhibitions, and markets. Free.
2816502.sponsor: Seoul Foundation for Arts and Culture

4060866.title: 104th Children's Day Ceremony
4060866.overview: The national Children's Day commemoration hosted by the welfare ministry: a formal ceremony with performances and programs centered on children's rights and healthy growth.

2986679.title: Family Month Children's Festival
2986679.overview: A 'kids-venture' amusement-park day at Yeongjong Seaside Park: circus, anime OST concerts, bubble and magic shows, samba percussion, bounce rides, mini trains, water play, treasure hunts, and family photo booths.

3114685.title: Little Farmer's Color Farm Adventure
3114685.overview: The National Agricultural Museum's Children's Day week: little farmers explore the museum turning a colorless countryside into a vivid color farm through performances, hands-on programs, and events.

1633367.title: Wonju Children's Day Festival
1633367.overview: A citizen-run Children's Day tradition since 1989, organized by Wonju's civic groups around themes of life, peace, and dreams — 2026 runs on 'dreams' with stages and programs at the Dancing Carnival grounds.

1004281.title: Uiwang Children's Railroad Festival
1004281.overview: Korea's only railway-themed children's festival, in its 20th year beside the Railroad Museum and Wangsong Lake: diesel-locomotive and train simulators, rail-safety quizzes, drawing contests, and family stages — train-mad kids' heaven.
1004281.place: Wangsong Lake Park and Railroad Museum

1806117.title: Growing with Science (Children's Day)
1806117.overview: Children's Day at the Incheon Children's Science Museum: science storytelling shows, family challenges, XR and robot-dog programs, rocket launches, solar-penguin builds, and craft benches across the museum.

3489432.title: Children's Day Library Festival
3489432.overview: The National Library for Children marks its 20th anniversary with a Children's Day festival — 'growing with stories': family reading programs, exhibitions, performances, a drawing-contest award ceremony, library golden bell quiz, and paper-plane wish launches.
3489432.place: National Library for Children and Young Adults

2978145.title: Love for Living Things Children's Festival
2978145.overview: A Children's Day festival at the National Institute of Biological Resources: play-based programs rediscovering Korea's endangered wildlife through a child's eyes and teaching biodiversity by doing.

1270240.title: Yuseong Hot Springs Culture Festival
1270240.overview: The signature festival of Daejeon's hot-spring district, genuinely resident-run: programs fusing Yuseong's two identities — healing waters and science city — with foot baths, performances, and neighborhood booths across Yurim Park.

3113671.title: National Bread Pride Festival
3113671.overview: Seoul's first national bread festival on the Garak Market sky garden: 22 famous bakeries from around the country, 100-plus breads, concerts and magic shows, bread cosplay with prizes, kids' zones, and coupon events among spring flowers.

538458.title: Ulsan Soeburi Iron Festival
538458.overview: Korea's only iron-culture festival, at Dalcheon Cheoljang — the peninsula's oldest iron mine, worked for two thousand years: live reenactments of traditional iron smelting, performances, and programs tracing how this ore became the root of Ulsan's industrial rise.

4060158.title: Hangang Seoraeseom Picnic Concert
4060158.overview: A spring picnic concert on Seoraeseom — the flower island in Banpo Hangang Park: acoustic bands and classical ensembles on the riverside stage, a picnic food market, treehouse and beanbag zones for lingering.

2490376.title: Gyeomjae Culture & Arts Festival
2490376.overview: Marking 350 years since the birth of Jeong Seon (Gyeomjae) — the master who invented true-view landscape painting — at the museum devoted to him: a national sketching contest, exhibitions, performances, and traditional games where he once painted the Han River's western reaches.

3303393.title: Busan Wheat Festival
3303393.overview: A food-culture festival on the wheat theme in Buk-gu — once a major wheat entrepôt: world wheat cuisines in a 3,200-pyeong camping-ground food lounge (zero-waste, QR ordering), plus lotus-pond programs and local collaborations.

141865.title: Uijeongbu Music Theatre Festival
141865.overview: Korea's dedicated music-theater festival, every May at the Uijeongbu Arts Center for 25 years: international productions alongside Korea's best, with open-air stages and lobby concerts where amateurs share billing with professionals.

2961451.title: Paju Spiel 2026
2961451.overview: Korea's answer to Essen Spiel: an outdoor board-game festival by Korea Boardgames drawing 20,000 players to the European-styled Paju campus — tables under spring sun in the gardens, from hardcore strategy to family-first fun. Free.

1954396.title: Daejeon Together Day Festival
1954396.overview: A World Day for Cultural Diversity festival at Seodaejeon Park: 33 experience and counseling booths, Kyrgyz dance, Chinese wushu, a world costume fashion show, visa and settlement consulting, and global games — Daejeon's residents and international community in one park.
1954396.sponsor: Daejeon Metropolitan City · Ministry of Justice
